rules.identity: Different canonical subjects or predicates are separate facts
rules.scope: Only fully specified, matching required contexts are comparable
rules.time: Publication time never substitutes for effective time
rules.quantity: Convert compatible linear units; keep qualifiers and intervals
rules.evidence: Check verified evidence scope and formation origins per assertion nature
rules.transition: Planned or underway to completed requires matching completion evidence
rules.taxonomy: Subtype paths classify concepts; they do not assert product implementation
